Pending plan edits — ALL APPLIED as of 2026-09-12 16:45 PDT

Items 1-7 were applied by Codex's in-place review (commit 680e0a9); items 8-9 by Claude (commit a6df4ec). Kept for the record.

Do not edit docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-12-swesim-implementation.md while Codex holds it.

  1. Task 1 (models): add OperationType.WITHHOLDING = "withholding"; allow Brief.provenance in {"original-issue", "withheld", "authored"}; add RunConfig.brief_profile: Literal["natural", "withheld"] = "withheld"; validator: if any brief has profile withheld, every withholding operation target must be a fact id with provenance == original-issue and a source_excerpt, and none of those excerpts may appear in the withheld brief text (case-insensitive substring); tests for both.
  2. Task 4 (compile): hidden and interactive use the brief selected by run_config.brief_profile (fall back to natural when no withheld brief exists); full always uses natural + visible facts. Test asserts the withheld brief text appears in hidden/interactive and the natural text in full.
  3. Task 6 (draft_spec): add a second LLM call withhold(natural_issue) -> {withheld_brief, removed: [{category, excerpt, kind, discovery}]} with categories: reproduction, error_message, expected_output, location, version, proposed_fix; convert removed into ledger facts (provenance: original-issue, source_url = issue URL, discovery per item) and operations entries of type withholding; run the code leak check and retry once with the violating excerpts listed if it fails.
  4. Task 6 tests: test_withheld_brief_has_no_excerpts with a fixture issue containing a traceback and a snippet.
  5. Task 10 (github-repo): add --kind feature|bugfix bands from spec section 6 and the target repo list (python-statemachine, kombu, gql, narwhals, pytest, textual, pypdf); default --max-prs 400.
  6. Task 12 (score): report brief_profile per group key (condition|brief_profile|run_config_hash); GOAL.md and verify.sh: add a check that at least one scenario has hidden runs on both natural and withheld.
  7. CLAUDE.md hard rules: "hidden and interactive always share the same brief profile; full is always natural + visible facts; withheld removals are category-targeted and every removal is a ledger fact with the reporter's excerpt."
  8. Task 6 (judge): add issue_contract_delta(row) -> dict (code-extracted: exception names and string literals in test_patch not in issue; new public defs in patch not in issue) fed into the judge prompt; add swesim judge-calibrate --n 150 --model ... that samples annotated instances, runs the judge with the Verified rubric (data: data/annotations/ensembled_annotations_public.csv; instructions: https://cdn.openai.com/introducing-swe-bench-verified/swe-b-annotation-instructions.pdf), and writes workspace/judge_calibration.json with agreement at the >=2 threshold, precision/recall, and a confusion table; docs/grading.md reports the number. Test: agreement computation on a synthetic set.
  9. Task 6 (judge schema): replace the single non_derivable_choice field with gaps: [{id, text, source: "test-literal|test-exception|patch-public-name|diff-branch|thread", derivable_from_repo: bool, consequential: bool, resolved_by: "thread|patch|none", category}] plus verified_rubric_score: 0-3; acceptance rule in code: keep = any(not g.derivable_from_repo and g.consequential and g.resolved_by == "thread" for g in gaps); default judge model openai/gpt-5.5 (different from the draft model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5), both recorded in difficulty.judged.
